newPlatforms.name: IndieMusicFans Worldwide Free Rock Radio Submission Form
newPlatforms.country: Worldwide; the first-party submission page welcomes indie rock bands and artists worldwide.
newPlatforms.submissionMethod: official first-party free music-submission page with an embedded online form for radio consideration

authorizedRoute.routeType: first-party public free-music-submission page with embedded online form
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Submit band or artist information and a meta-tagged MP3 for possible streaming on IndieMusicFans/OTAT247 radio.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Open the official contact page, inspect the embedded form manually without bypassing any control, verify rights and AI disclosures, select a suitable MarcsMusic track, complete approved fields and submit only after explicit owner approval.
authorizedRoute.internationalAcceptanceEvidence: The first-party submission page states that indie rock bands and artists worldwide are welcome.
authorizedRoute.standardRouteFeeEvidence: The first-party page describes the route as free music submission with no fees to get started.

publishedRequirements: submit as an independent artist or band
prepare track(s) in meta-tagged MP3 format
use the online form on the official contact page
submit music within the published Rock, Metal, Ska, Punk or Synth/EDM/Pop scope
grant permission for IndieMusicFans radio to stream the submitted track while retaining ownership rights
submissionRequirements.publishedReviewTiming: Submissions are usually reviewed within 1–2 weeks, subject to availability and open on-air slots.
safeReviewScope: inspect the embedded online form manually
verify whether CAPTCHA, login, email collection or other human-verification controls are present
identify every required field, upload control, accepted file type and file-size limit
confirm privacy, data-use, streaming and promotional consent language
confirm the exact territory, duration, revocation and reuse scope of the streaming permission
confirm whether AI-assisted music is eligible and whether entirely AI-generated music is excluded
check track-count, release-recency and clean/explicit-content rules
verify MP3 metadata and select a genre-compatible MarcsMusic track
submit manually only after owner approval
unresolvedEligibility: CAPTCHA, login or email-verification requirement inside the embedded form
audio upload mechanism and maximum file size
streaming permission territory, duration and revocation terms
AI-assisted versus entirely AI-generated music eligibility
follow-up method and exact review timing for a specific submission

emails.purpose: First-party published fallback address for questions not answered in the FAQ.

adjacentEmailsExcluded: otat247@gmail.com is retained as a public business-question contact but excluded as the canonical music-submission route because the page instructs artists to use the online form.
businessContact.emailStatus: One public fallback business email is first-party published and syntactically valid. It uses Gmail rather than the site domain but is context aligned. The canonical authorized submission route remains the online form.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax and stated purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: No CAPTCHA was visible in the accessible page text; the embedded form itself was not passively field-inspected and remains unverified.
formBoundary.loginStatus: No login requirement was published on the accessible page; any embedded-form authentication boundary remains unverified.
formBoundary.paymentStatus: The route is explicitly described as free and no payment requirement was published.
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The embedded form must be inspected by a human for fields, upload limits, CAPTCHA/login, privacy, consent, rights and AI-policy boundaries before use.
rightsOrConsentFields: submission grants permission for IndieMusicFans radio to stream the track
submitter must disclose any AI elements
adjacentRoutesExcluded: fallback FAQ email as a direct music-submission route
any paid promotion not stated on the official free-submission page

activityVerification.evidence: The current first-party station page publishes active recurring programming, including weekly and monthly shows, and describes ongoing worldwide curation across rock, metal, punk, ska, synthwave, EDM and acoustic music.

genreFitEvidence: The first-party submission FAQ explicitly accepts Synth/EDM/Pop alongside Rock, Metal, Ska and Punk.
The current station page lists Synthwave and EDM in its rotation.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, pop or crossover tracks may fit after human track-level review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is active, worldwide-facing and free, but the embedded form was not passively field-inspected. A human must verify all fields, audio-upload limits, CAPTCHA/login, privacy and streaming-permission terms; assess the AI disclosure policy and rights status; select a suitable track; and complete the form manually.

dedupeTerms: IndieMusicFans Worldwide Free Rock Radio Submission Form
deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Searches in the accessible repository code-search surface for the platform domain returned no match before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The first-party contact/submission page and its embedded form are stored as one canonical opportunity. The FAQ email is retained only as a fallback business contact and not as a separate submission route.

notes: One IndieMusicFans opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form was filled, no email was sent, no file was uploaded, no login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
